hook.title: Naam se dhoondho, number se nahi
hook.md:
Pharmacist yeh nahi kehta ki "formulary ki teesri drug do". Woh poochhta hai "**Ibuprofen** ka adult dose kya hai?" Patient ki file bhi position se nahi padhi jaati: aap **age**, **blood group**, **allergies** dhoondhte hain.

Kram wali readings ke liye lists badhiya hain. Par jo jaankari **naam se** dhoondhi jaati hai, uske liye Python ke paas **dictionary** hai. Aur chhote records ke liye jo kabhi nahi badalne chahiye, jaise 128 over 84 ka blood pressure, uske paas **tuple** hai.

learn: **Tuple** ek fixed record kaise rakhta hai, aur use kyun nahi badal sakte
Tuple ko alag variables mein **unpack** karna
**Dictionary** **key: value** pairs kaise rakhti hai, jo key se dhoondhe jaate hain
Values jodna, badalna, **get()** se surakshit dhoondhna, aur dictionary par loop chalana

explanation.heading: Tuples: records jo nahi badalte
explanation.md:
**Tuple** list jaisa hai, par **round brackets** se likha jaata hai, aur banne ke baad **badla nahi ja sakta**:

```python
bp = (128, 84)
print(bp)
print("Systolic:", bp[0])
print("Diastolic:", bp[1])
print(len(bp))
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
(128, 84)
Systolic: 128
Diastolic: 84
2
```

Indexing, slicing aur `len()` bilkul lists ki tarah kaam karte hain. Par `bp[0] = 130` error deta hai, kyunki tuples **immutable** hain. Yeh khoobi hai: darj ki gayi reading, ya drug ka (name, strength) pair, galti se nahi badalna chahiye.

callout.title: Tuple
callout.md: Round brackets mein kram wala collection, jaise (128, 84). Ise list ki tarah padh sakte hain par kabhi badal nahi sakte.

explanation.heading: Tuple ko unpack karna
explanation.md:
Ek line mein tuple ko alag-alag variables mein baant sakte hain. Ise **unpacking** kehte hain:

```python
drug = ("Amoxicillin", 500, "mg")
name, strength, unit = drug
print(name)
print(strength, unit)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
Amoxicillin
500 mg
```

Baayin taraf variables ki sankhya tuple ke items ki sankhya ke barabar honi chahiye. Ek baat aur: ek item wale tuple ko comma chahiye, `("Aspirin",)`, kyunki `("Aspirin")` brackets mein sirf ek string hai.

explanation.heading: Dictionaries: key aur value
explanation.md:
**Dictionary** **curly braces** ke andar **key: value** ke pairs rakhti hai. Value ko uski key se square brackets mein dhoondhte hain:

```python
patient = {"name": "Ravi", "age": 54, "blood_group": "B+"}
print(patient["name"])
print(patient["age"])
print(len(patient))
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
Ravi
54
3
```

Keys aam taur par strings hoti hain, jaise `"name"` ya kisi drug ka naam. Values kuch bhi ho sakti hain: numbers, strings, yahaan tak ki lists bhi. `len()` pairs ginta hai.

callout.title: Dictionary
callout.md: Curly braces mein key: value pairs ka collection, jaise {"name": "Ravi", "age": 54}. Value ko position se nahi, key se dhoondhte hain.

explanation.heading: Badalna aur jodna
explanation.md:
Dictionaries mutable hain. Pehle se maujood key ko value dene par woh **update** hoti hai; nayi key ko value dene par naya pair **judta** hai:

```python
patient = {"name": "Ravi", "age": 54, "blood_group": "B+"}
patient["age"] = 55
patient["allergy"] = "Penicillin"
print(patient)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
{'name': 'Ravi', 'age': 55, 'blood_group': 'B+', 'allergy': 'Penicillin'}
```

Dictionary mein har key sirf ek baar aati hai, isliye age badli gayi, dohraayi nahi gayi.

explanation.heading: Surakshit lookup aur loop
explanation.md:
Jo key nahi hai use maangne par `KeyError` aata hai. `get()` isse bachaata hai: woh uski jagah default value deta hai. `in` keys check karta hai, aur `.items()` loop ke liye har key aur value deta hai:

```python
stock = {"Paracetamol": 120, "Cetirizine": 45}
print(stock.get("Aspirin", 0))
print("Cetirizine" in stock)
for drug, qty in stock.items():
    print(drug, qty)
```

Yeh print karta hai:

```
0
True
Paracetamol 120
Cetirizine 45
```

Aspirin stock mein nahi hai, isliye `get` ne default, 0, lautaaya.

callout.title: List, tuple ya dictionary?
callout.md: Kram wali readings jo badh sakti hain, unke liye list. Fixed record ke liye tuple. Jab naam se dhoondhna ho, tab dictionary.

walkthrough.intro: Yeh program adult doses ek dictionary mein rakhta hai, drug ke naam se ek dose dhoondhta hai, phir ek nayi drug jodta hai.

Naya pair jodo (key pehle se ho to update karo).

Comment batata hai ki doses milligrams mein hain aur drug ke naam se dhoondhe jaate hain.
Curly braces dictionary banaate hain. Har drug ka naam key hai, aur uska dose value hai. Teen pairs hain.
drug mein woh naam hai jo humein dhoondhna hai: Ibuprofen.
doses of drug, key Ibuprofen dhoondhta hai aur uski value deta hai, chaar sau. Koi position nahi ginni.
Amoxicillin abhi key nahi hai, isliye yeh line naya pair jodti hai: Amoxicillin, paanch sau.

errors.intro: Ek error na hone wali key se aati hai, doosri tuple badalne ki koshish se.

examples.title: Aisi key dhoondhna jo hai hi nahi
examples.md: `"Aspirin"` naam ki koi key nahi hai. Pehle `"Aspirin" in doses` se check kijiye, ya error ki jagah default paane ke liye `doses.get("Aspirin", 0)` use kijiye. Keys case-sensitive bhi hain: `"paracetamol"` aur `"Paracetamol"` ek nahi.

examples.title: Tuple ka item badalna
examples.md: Tuples badle nahi ja sakte. Uski jagah naya tuple banaiye, `bp = (130, 84)`, ya agar values sach mein badalni hain to list use kijiye.

mistakes.fix: Dictionaries key se dhoondhi jaati hain: `patient["name"]`.

mistakes.mistake: Ek item ka tuple bina comma ke likhna: `("Aspirin")`
mistakes.see: Koi error nahi, par yeh tuple nahi, string hai

mistakes.fix: Keys bilkul milni chahiye, capital letters samet.

mistakes.mistake: Galat sankhya ke variables mein unpack karna: `name, strength = ("Amoxicillin", 500, "mg")`
mistakes.see: ValueError: too many values to unpack
mistakes.fix: Har item ke liye ek variable: `name, strength, unit = ...`.

quiz.why: Dictionaries key: value pairs ke saath curly braces use karti hain.
Tuples immutable hain, isliye item assignment se TypeError aata hai.

quiz.q: Jab "x" key na ho to d["x"] kya deta hai?
quiz.why: Na hone wali key KeyError deti hai; get() isse bachaata hai.
Insulin key nahi hai, isliye get() default, 0, lautaata hai.

quiz.q: Patient ki details field ke naam se (name, age, blood group) rakhne ke liye sabse achha kya hai?
quiz.why: Dictionary se har detail uske naam se dhoondhi ja sakti hai.

exam.note: Practice ke liye important questions. University ke asli questions alag ho sakte hain.

summary: **Tuple** round brackets mein likha jaata hai, `(128, 84)`; use list ki tarah padhte hain par **badal nahi sakte**.
**Unpacking** tuple ko variables mein baantta hai: `name, strength = ("Amoxicillin", 500)`.
**Dictionary** curly braces mein **key: value** pairs rakhti hai aur key se dhoondhi jaati hai: `doses["Ibuprofen"]`.
`d[key] = value` maujooda key ko update karta hai ya nayi jodta hai; keys unique aur case-sensitive hain.
Na hone wali key **KeyError** deti hai; `d.get(key, default)` aur `key in d` isse bachaate hain, aur `d.items()` pairs par loop chalaata hai.

steps.say: Dictionary pairs rakhti hai. Har drug ka naam key hai, aur uska dose value.
Python seedhe key Ibuprofen par jaata hai aur uski value lautaata hai, chaar sau. Koi position nahi ginni padti.
Nayi key ko value dene se naya pair judta hai: Amoxicillin, paanch sau.
in keys check karta hai. Aspirin unmein nahi hai, isliye jawaab False hai.

glossary.meaning: Round brackets mein kram wala collection, jaise (128, 84). Ise list ki tarah padh sakte hain par kabhi badal nahi sakte.
Banne ke baad badla nahi ja sakta. Tuples aur strings immutable hain.
Ek line mein tuple ko alag variables mein baantna: name, strength = ("Amoxicillin", 500).
Curly braces mein key: value pairs ka collection. Value ko position se nahi, uski key se dhoondhte hain.
Woh naam jisse value dhoondhte hain, jaise dose dictionary mein "Ibuprofen". Har key sirf ek baar aati hai.
Key ke neeche jo rakha hai: "Ibuprofen": 400 mein 400. Yeh kisi bhi type ka ho sakta hai.
Jab dictionary mein na hone wali key dhoondhein tab aane wali error.
Key ko surakshit dhoondhta hai: d.get(key, default) KeyError ki jagah default deta hai.
